title: Young Woman Wilma Sitting on Porch, 1946 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from the post-WWII era showing a young smiling woman named Wilma sitting on the front porch steps of a Craftsman bungalow house. She is wearing a light-colored dress with dark trim and a decorative hairpiece or bow. The house features characteristic stone column bases and a dark shaded porch. The back bears handwritten notes reading 'Wilma '46 or 47' and a developer stamp 'B11'.
